profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary:
Hands-on engineering and practical leadership that helps teams ship reliable software. I help teams plan clearly, unblock fast, and deliver predictably. PSM I certified.

12+ years building Java/.NET/Python/TypeScript applications with CI/CD, automated testing, Docker, and Kubernetes.

I help teams deliver by turning complex work into clear, shared ways of working. I communicate operating models and program priorities so teams stay aligned, make good decisions quickly, and keep momentum.

Outside of work, I’m an avid reader, love to travel, and spend most of my time with my wife, our daughter, and our two golden retrievers.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Release train engineer for multiple teams on a large program in Defense Systems.

positions.title: Prinicipal Engineer Software
positions.description: Skills: C# · Kubernetes · DevSecOps · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · Jenkins

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• I am a full stack software engineer on a small cross functional team within a larger overall team, in an Agile environment using mostly Java, AngularJS and related tools, including automated testing (Selenium, Protractor).
• I work closely with my team members, providing support for skills I have more knowledge in and learning from them in areas new to me. I am passionate about continued professional development.

positions.title: Developer/QA
positions.description:
Turned manual tests cases into automated test suites using Selenium, for a variety of the products at the company. 
Added stress testing using Jmeter and API testing using Postman.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Was a software engineer on a small cross functional team within a larger overall team, in an Agile environment using mostly Java, AngularJS and related tools. 
• I work closely with my team members, providing support for skills I have more knowledge in and learning from them in areas new to me. I am passionate about continued professional development.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Graduated from an intense 12 week program that teaches students the skills necessary to be a Full-stack Web Developer.

positions.title: Network Information Officer
positions.description:
Was the Network Information Officer at TSA Austin, duties included delivering workforce information-sharing briefings on a  regular periodic basis; compile information binders; collect, record, and share program metrics to include the number  of employees briefed and the number of briefings conducted.
Collateral Duties: 
- Volunteered for the Explosive Trace Detection Maintenance Technician position, was accepted and completed all required training. 
- A volunteer for The Department of Homeland Security Surge Capacity Force, and completed all the required training, including several FEMA courses and exams.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description: Updated the computers in the Mass Media lab, ran disk utilities, performance checks, software upgrades and gave assistance to anyone in the lab in need of help.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Interned for the Management Unit. Several of the projects I worked on were:
•	Safety Review Committee 
•	Project Safe Neighborhood
•	Compiling alcohol data on minors arrested by the Lincoln Police Department, using Excel to create graphs and charts, and making a presentation on my findings to the Substance Abuse Committee
•	Filing all the General Orders, Special Orders and Standard Operating Procedures in 455 files for their National Accreditation.

volunteerExperiences.description: Lots of training and being prepared to be called up to help at any moment
